=== note right of
class A
note right of A : important
=== note positions
class A
note left of A : l
note top of A : t
note bottom of A : b
note right of A : r
=== note without of
class A
note right : on last
=== note nothing to note to
note right : nothing
=== note of unknown
note right of Unknown : x
=== named notes
note "Floating" as N1
class A
A .. N1
note "Other" as N2 #red
note "Third" as N3 <<st>>
note "Tagged" as N4 $tag
=== named note exists
note "a" as N
note "b" as N
=== note multiline
class A
note right of A
  line 1
  line 2
end note
note as N
  floating
  text
endnote
note left of A {
  braces
}
=== note multiline indentation
class A
note right of A
    indented
      more
    back
end note
=== note colors and stereotypes
class A
note right of A #pink : colored
note left of A <<st>> : stereo
note top of A <<st>> #red : both
note bottom of A #back:yellow;line:red : full
=== note url
class A
note right of A [[http://x]] : url single
note left of A [[http://y]]
  multi
end note
=== note on link
class A
class B
A --> B
note on link : on link
note left on link #red : colored
note right of link
  multi
end note
=== note on link without link
class A
note on link : x
=== note on empty link note
A --> B
note on link
end note
=== note on link skips notes
class A
A --> B
note right of A : n
note on link : on the AB link
=== tips
class A {
  field
  method()
}
note left of A::field
  tip on field
end note
note right of A::method
  tip on method
end note
note right of A::"method"
  quoted member
end note
note left of A::other {
  bracket tip
}
note right of A::method <<st>> #red
  colored
end note
=== tip nothing
note left of X::y
  tip
end note
=== constraint on links
A --> B
C --> D
constraint on links : constraint text
=== constraint too few
A --> B
constraint on links : x
=== note with rankdir
left to right direction
class A
note right of A : becomes bottom
note top of A : becomes left
=== kermor
!pragma kermor true
package p {
}
note right of p : group note
note top of p : top
=== note on note link
note "n" as N
class A
N .. A
note right of N : note of note
